verdict.rationale: The documented API only covers file transcription: you upload a completed recording up to 25 MB, and the 'stream' option streams output text while the model processes that file. That is not live audio input over a WebSocket or streaming endpoint. The community reports of real-time captioning rely on third-party tools (whisper.cpp's streaming sample, Buzz), not on a documented first-party live-streaming endpoint, so they earn no credit.
